semantic.justification: Original finite DATE/DATETIME mode0 producers use actual calendar, compiled token and Date/Time owners. Source Gregorian range/epoch mutation, original calendar switching/Dummy-era fallback/restoration, implicit other-calendar detection, grammatical month case, years/eras/week/quarter, literals/star/blanks and separate datetime date/clock rounding are connected. Dormant nonzero native-number/spellout branches remain unported and are not admitted. Complete native display/parser/service ABI closure remains unverified. Original saved-calendar, fractional-second and final-output owners are now covered when a later buffer constructor throws. Calendar switching/restoration and date/time rounding results are unchanged. Native aborting raw C-buffer growth remains outside exception-unwinding certification. Original DATE/DATETIME native-number forwarding now passes compiled NatNum to each calendar field and the actual wrapper to integer week/time fields. Year zero padding is transliterated separately before appending the calendar year; signed years/names/literals/fractions retain original order. Supersedes the former mode0-only limitation for modes0..11. NatNum12 selected-field spellout and full native display wrapper remain unported.
